body:
Part of #2349. Behind the existing `richChatContent` flag.

## Problem
The maintainer saw an agent reply with an absolute PDF path in inline code, `~/source/<other-repo>/…/file.pdf`. No file chip appeared.

- A chip only appears once main confirms the path is inside the agent's roots: project, worktree, or live session-output dir (`agentRoots`, `src/main/services/agent-runtime/chat-files.ts:48-68`).
- Anything else is quietly turned back into plain text (`FileChips.tsx:106-118`, `demote()`).
- PDFs have no preview kind. `kindOf` (`chat-files.ts:116-125`) knows only image, video, audio and text (no NUL in the first 4 KB), else "other". A PDF with no NUL in its first 4 KB is shown as raw `%PDF-…` text.

## Maintainer decision (2026-10-29)
Once an agent has terminal and tool access, assume it has broad control: it could just copy the file into the project. So the allowlist adds friction without real protection. **Drop the root allowlist for file chips, previews, Markdown images and media cards.** This applies locally and over Annex alike.

## Scope
1. **Access:**
   - Any path that resolves to an existing regular file the app user can read gets a chip, wherever it is.
   - Keep the checks that are about correctness or resources, not confinement: resolve the real path, regular files only, no FIFOs or devices, no blocking opens, MIME sniffing, the existing byte, pixel and preview-size limits, and the remote-fetch click requirement.
   - Remove or simplify the root checks in `agentRoots` / `resolveAllowedPath` and their callers, including #2422's session-output and "outside the project" reasons, where they only exist for confinement. Keep "not found" and "too large" reasons.
   - Note: Copilot asset resolution (#2421) reads its own session journal by sha. That's lookup, not confinement, so leave it.
2. **PDF:**
   - Detect PDFs by their `%PDF-` header, before the text check.
   - Render with pdf.js, not Chromium's PDF plugin (keep `plugins` off): a first-page thumbnail in the popover, a paged preview with page count, and Open in Files / Reveal.
   - Respect a size limit, and lazy-load pdf.js only when a PDF preview opens.
3. **Denied or unknown states:** a path that can't be shown (missing, too large, unsupported) stays visible as a muted chip with a reason tooltip, not silent plain text.

## Acceptance
- An absolute path outside the project to an existing PDF, image or text file gets a chip and a working preview.
- PDFs show page 1 and page navigation, and a PDF never renders as text.
- Missing or too-large files show a reason.
- With the flag off, nothing changes.
- Tests cover: outside-project paths; a PDF with and without NUL bytes in its header; a large PDF over the limit; a missing path.
- Typecheck, lint and the full test suite pass.
- No AI-slop UI.

title: [MEDIUM] Rich chat files: chip any readable path (drop the project-only allowlist), preview PDFs, and stop PDFs misdetecting as text
